title: Bob Lazar's sport model grown out of the vacuum

tellings.quote: and then Bob Lazar mentioned at one point that it seemed to him that the so-called sports model was as if grown out of the vacuum itself
saw that and I I remember his words that this sports mile is as if it was 3D printed our space time. That's exactly what that equation says.
tellings.difference: Says '3D printed in our spacetime' rather than 'grown out of the vacuum', ties it to Pais's super force equation and places it at S-4 in 1989.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Pais retelling Lazar's remark that the sport model seemed formed out of spacetime or the vacuum itself.

as_told.title: Lazar's sport model as if 3D printed in our spacetime, matching the super force equation

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site he calls S-4, is said to have described one craft, which he called the sport model, as if it had been grown out of the vacuum of empty space itself. The Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual craft designs, repeats this, and in a second version remembers Lazar's words as the craft being like something 3D printed in our spacetime, placing it at S-4 in 1989. Pais says this is exactly what his own equation for a single unifying force describes, so to him Lazar's account fits his physics.
